cause: Navigation help is absolutely positioned over the full-height canvas. Camera fitting uses the full canvas dimensions, so fitted unit-cell corners can be covered by the help strip.
proposedRootFix: Lay out the existing navigation help in its own row below a flexible canvas. The renderer observes the actual unobstructed canvas size. Hide the entire row at the current responsive breakpoints so it returns its space to the canvas. Add no buttons.
